rule: Self-evolution is gated by evidence. When live mutation results show systematic max_steps failures on the same class (ledger, topo, etc.), the correct agentic move is to raise the measured budget or improve the tool path and re-measure. Do not invent scores. Do not declare victory on partial. Record only what the scoreboard and holdout actually say. After every meaningful measurement, update FINDINGS or the scoreboard path so future-you has ground truth.
